snippet.title: Abide - Official Trailer | Six One Indie Showcase May 2026
snippet.description:
A peaceful retreat where people go to get better. A place for people to air their demons. ABIDE is a first-person horror game using prosthetic gore effects, stop motion, and dolls scanned into 3d models. 
Head over to Steam and add Abide to your Wishlist.
